execution_rule: Complete all construction within a tranche or bounded prerequisite before running its validation checks; batch validation repairs and rerun only the smallest applicable final gate.

items.title: Guided Alpha framework
items.acceptance_summary: Persistent role-safe Guided Alpha shell exposes identity, role, exact candidate context, connection mode, reference Campaign, round, objective, expected result, progress, report/reset/connection/limitations controls and preserves GM navigation repair.

items.title: Automatic diagnostics foundation
items.acceptance_summary: Guided Alpha automatically captures privacy-bounded system-known build/account/role/round/browser/connection/error context and writes in-progress/final JSON diagnostics on the host laptop; package/runner seams are reusable by T02 and later tranches.

items.title: Glass Harbor reference Campaign integration
items.acceptance_summary: Validated Glass Harbor Incident / Meridian Testbed fixture becomes a deterministic coherent application test Campaign with reset and emits pertinent system-known evidence through the automatic diagnostics foundation.

items.title: Guided scenario and test-journey engine
items.acceptance_summary: Machine-readable role-aware scenarios guide repeatable objectives/actions/expected results/recovery/reset/outcomes across progressively larger test charters.

items.title: Frictionless evidence and defect capture
items.remaining_scope_after_foundation: Attach scenario/step/application-area/synthetic-state context, tester-perceived/expected input, defect classification and reproducibility packaging to the already-installed automatic diagnostics transport/export substrate.
items.acceptance_summary: Safe system-known context is combined with the minimal tester-supplied perception/expectation needed for reproducible classified defect bundles.

items.title: Device and trusted-LAN connection center
items.acceptance_summary: Same-LAN device setup is guided; server/port/network/firewall/request state is visible; failures are classified by layer and temporary access can be cleaned up.

items.title: Testing operations and control layer
items.acceptance_summary: Rounds, assignments, coverage, defects, changed-code retests and highest-value-next-test selection are visible and actionable.

items.title: Remote-online-ready Guided Alpha architecture
items.acceptance_summary: Guidance/scenario/evidence contracts and UI are transport-neutral and ready for Remote Test Session activation without rebuilding the testing system.

items.title: Remote Test Session activation
items.acceptance_summary: Remote joining/reconnect/latency/session visibility uses the governed authoritative runtime; no public exposure workaround substitutes for missing dependencies.

items.title: Cross-location Guided Alpha and permanent regression loop
items.acceptance_summary: Geographically separated GM/Player guided session plus adverse reconnect/permission/concurrency cases completes and becomes durable regression coverage.
